'''Ashley''' is a female student of Department of Light Energy Sciences, talking about a rumor "miko" with her classmate, '''Stephanie'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ashley:''' Hey, listen to this new rumor I heard!
:'''Ashley:''' They say if you ever get lost alone out on the frostlands, all you have to do is hope, pray, and wait...
:'''Ashley:''' When a white bird appears, a "miko" with white hair dressed in red will suddenly materialize, escort you back to the Academy, and then vanish without a trace...
:'''Ashley:''' Magical, right? I wonder why she isn't one of the Academy's Great Mysteries?
:'''Stephanie:''' Probably because... a few days ago, I literally saw that exact "miko" having tea with President [[Lucilla]] in her office.
:'''Ashley:''' WHAT?!
:'''Stephanie:''' She's probably just a researcher who keeps to herself. Students rarely see her.
:'''Stephanie:''' Besides, most students don't wander into the frostlands alone, do they?
:'''Ashley:'''  Fair, fair... but from the way they described her outfit, it's neither modern nor Royan. Where on Solaris did she come from...
{{Dialogue End}}
